name: Kaede ~Injoku ni Ochiru Mahou Shoujo~
original_name: KAEDE ～淫辱に堕ちる魔法少女～
source:
Sakaki Seiji signed a contract with a demon.
The thing standing between him and ultimate power is a young girl also contracted... to stop him!
Her name was Kaede Tendo. She had more than enough fighting spirit. But Seiji bypassed her surface level defenses.

Can Kaede deny the pleasure that's corroding her soul? 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE120917.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
榊诚司与恶魔签订了契约。
挡在他和终极力量之间的是一个同样契约的年轻女孩……来阻止他！
她的名字叫天童枫。她的斗志已经足够了。但Seiji绕过了她的表面防御。

枫能否认腐蚀她灵魂的快乐吗？

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE120917.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
